'''Dilham''' is the [[innkeeper]] of [[Culain's Hound]], an inn in the city of [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
He is a round-faced man with three chins and wears a white apron that strains around his bulk.{{Ref/book|6|10}} 

==Activities==
He houses [[Alanna Mosvani]] and [[Verin Mathwin]] leading a group of about a dozen [[novices]] to be from the [[Two Rivers]].

His inn is visited by the [[Dragon Reborn]] himself, who in anger at their disbelief scares them through a demonstration of ''[[saidin]]''. Shortly afterwards, in the separate dining hall of the inn, Alanna Mosvani attempts to trick the [[Pattern]] by [[bonding]] him.
